additionalRemarks._instruction: Enter any additional remarks concerning this digital representation.

capturedWith._instruction: Add the device used to capture this digital representation.

coordinateFramework._instruction: Add the coordinate space in which this digital representation exists.

dataLocation._instruction: Add the location of the file or file bundle in which the digital representation is stored.

dimension._instruction: Enter the common dimension of the consecutive images (frames) in pixels.

name._instruction: Enter a descriptive name of this digital representation preferably matching the filename.

numberOfImages._instruction: Enter the total number of images in this sequence (at least two).

pixelSize._instruction: Enter the common physical pixel size for the consecutive images (frames) (in x,y order).

temporalSamplingFrequency._instruction: Enter the rate at which consecutive images (frames) are captured in a sequence, preferably measured in Hertz (Hz).
